description: Mobile device support with responsive canvas scaling, on-screen touch controls, and touch-friendly UI

userStories.title: Responsive canvas scaling
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the game to fit my screen so that I can see the full play area without scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: Canvas element scales down to fit viewport width on screens narrower than 800px via CSS max-width: 100% and height: auto
The .canvas-wrapper and .game-container don't cause horizontal overflow on small screens
The h1 SPACE INVADERS title uses a smaller font-size on screens under 840px via media query
No horizontal scrolling on a 375px-wide viewport
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill with mobile emulation

userStories.title: On-screen touch controls
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want on-screen buttons to move and shoot so that I can play without a keyboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Touch control bar appears at the bottom of the viewport with left arrow, fire, and right arrow buttons
Pressing (touchstart) left/right sets keys['ArrowLeft']/keys['ArrowRight'] in the keys object
Releasing (touchend) clears the key so movement stops
Tapping fire sets keys[' '] briefly to fire a shot
Holding a direction button provides continuous movement
Buttons are at least 48x48px for comfortable tapping
Controls are semi-transparent with dark background matching game aesthetic
Controls only visible on touch devices (use @media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) or JS touch detection)
Controls do not appear on desktop browsers
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill with mobile emulation

userStories.title: Touch-friendly UI and scroll prevention
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the UI to be usable on a small screen and the page to not scroll while playing.
acceptanceCriteria: CSS touch-action: manipulation on body to prevent double-tap zoom
touchmove events on canvas and touch controls call preventDefault() during gameplay to stop page scrolling
Overlay buttons (Start Game, Register, Log In, etc.) have minimum 44px height for tapping
Auth form inputs are at least 44px tall
Game over overlay is scrollable within itself if content overflows on small screens (overflow-y: auto)
Viewport meta tag is present with width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill with mobile emulation
